integrity: All general statements have elementary analytic proofs; a standard-library exact-rational verifier is included as a supplementary finite check. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No extensions to dependent utilities, nonbinary values, more than two agents, or a growing number of goods in the rare-value limit. At leading-order rare-value ties, no finite-rate winner is asserted. Publication priority remains qualified by unindexed earlier results.
scientific_scope: Two agents, independent per-agent Bernoulli item utilities, precommitted complete allocations; exact four-good EF1-success optimum and fixed-m rare-value limit.
title: Sharp four-good asymmetry and the quadratic rare-event law for realized EF1
